summary: DDC Enterprise Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a share repurchase program approved by its board on June 9, 2026. The program authorizes up to $10 million in purchases of Class A ordinary shares, limited to 20% of outstanding shares, over 18 months. Repurchases may occur via 10b5-1 plans or open market purchases, with timing at management's discretion. Funding comes from free cash flow, and Bitcoin may be used as collateral for related arrangements. The program is not binding and may be suspended at any time. Watch for execution pace and Bitcoin collateral impact.
